title: Concept: webpack development client served in production
description: The webpack dev client keeps a rebuild socket open and serves modules from memory. Shipping that page means the build pipeline was bypassed for a deployment, so the artefact users are testing is not the artefact that was reviewed, and the socket is an unauthenticated channel into the build.
applicability: Responses that serve a JavaScript application built with webpack.
risk: Users receive unreviewed code from a development server, and the hot-reload socket gives anyone who reaches it a channel into the build process.
